newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bay of Plenty sees yr profit over $7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bay of Plenty sees yr profit over $7 mln.

text.p: Bay of Plenty Electricity said on Friday it expected tax-paid profit for the year to March 1997 to exceed NZ$7 million.
The company reported an unaudited tax paid profit of $4.03 million for the September half year which compares with $3.54 million for the corresponding period last year.
The first-half profit was achieved on total income of $32.5 million and includes $1.5 million from the recently opened cogeneration plant at Edgecumbe.
The company said the result was especially pleasing given that depreciation charges rose to $1.68 million from $1.20 million as a result of a revaluation of assets.
"Directors continue to see benefits in increased generation capacity and the company is actively pursuing several projects," the company said.
BOP recently announced a joint venture with Natural Gas Corporation to build a 20 megawatt cogeneration plant at Kapuni with completion in 1997.
